scripts.lint: npm run lint:typecheck && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:workflows && npm run lint:workflow-paths

scripts.prove:browser-share-link: npx turbo run build --filter=@beeline/server... && node --import tsx scripts/prove-browser-share-link.ts
scripts.prove:public-post: npx turbo run build --filter=@beeline/server... --filter=@beeline/body... && node --import tsx scripts/prove-public-post.ts
